अमिताभ बच्चन के रविवार वाले संडे दर्शन में इस बार दिखा एक बहुत बड़ा बदलाव! 🛡️

हर रविवार की तरह अमिताभ बच्चन मुंबई के जुहू स्थित अपने बंगले Jalsa के बाहर फैंस का अभिवादन करने पहुंचे।
लेकिन इस बार बिग बी खुले में नहीं, बल्कि एक पारदर्शी बुलेटप्रूफ शील्ड के अंदर खड़े होकर फैंस को हाथ हिलाते नजर आए। 😲
रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, हाल ही में मुंबई के BKC क्षेत्र के एक स्कूल में मुंबई पुलिस को बम की धमकी वाला ईमेल मिला था, जिसमें बिग बी के बंगले को निशाना बनाने का जिक्र था।
सुरक्षा के इस कड़े इंतजाम के बीच उनके बेटे Abhishek Bachchan भी पिता के ठीक पीछे चौकन्ने खड़े होकर भीड़ पर नजर रख रहे थे। 👮‍♂️
बता दें कि हाल ही में अमिताभ बच्चन ने अपने ब्लॉग, Tumblr और X पर हेल्थ अपडेट शेयर कर बताया था कि डॉक्टरों ने उन्हें आराम की सलाह दी है।

क्या आपको भी सुरक्षा का यह नया इंतजाम सही लगा? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय जरूर दें! 👇

ctx.title: Amitabh Bachchan waves to fans from protective shield outside Jalsa amid security concerns, son Abhishek stands guard
ctx.summary: Amitabh Bachchan made sure to continue his long-standing tradition of greeting fans outside his Juhu bungalow, Jalsa, on Sundays.
ctx.text:
Veteran star Amitabh Bachchan has been interacting with fans outside his residence in Mumbai, Jalsa, every Sunday. This is a tradition he has been continuing for years. This Sunday too, Amitabh made it a point to briefly come out of his house and greet hundreds of fans. But this time, the actor was seen greeting them from inside a transparent protective bulletproof shell, reportedly added as an extra security measure.
The veteran actor stepped out of his Juhu bungalow to greet the large crowd gathered outside. However, unlike his usual Sunday appearances, Bachchan was seen standing inside a transparent protective enclosure. The actor waved at his fans and greeted them with his signature style.
The actor was also accompanied by his son, Abhishek Bachchan, during his weekly meeting with fans. While Amitabh greeted the crowd, Abhishek stood behind his father, keeping a watchful eye on the crowd.
The actor can be seen standing inside the enclosure with his hand raised as fans gathered outside to catch a glimpse of him. Security personnel were also present at the spot.
The additional security arrangement comes after a bomb threat email allegedly targeting the actor’s bungalow was reported to Mumbai Police in October. The threatening email was reportedly received by a school in Mumbai’s Bandra-Kurla Complex (BKC) area, following which the police started an investigation.
A bomb threat email allegedly targeting veteran actor Amitabh Bachchan’s bungalow in Mumbai was reported to Mumbai Police on Friday, last week. The threatening email was received by a school in Mumbai’s Bandra-Kurla Complex (BKC) area. Mumbai Police have launched an investigation into the matter.
Meanwhile, Amitabh Bachchan raised quite a few eyebrows on Wednesday as he shared a post on his blog about his health condition. He shared that he will take a break from his usual social media updates after being advised to rest and recover. On Friday, Amitabh shared another health update on his Tumblr account. He said, “Yet more rest needed .. adjusting .. thinking and wondering ..the human body and its uniqueness.”
Earlier, he made a post on X in which he revealed the doctor's advice and wrote in Hindi, "Apologies. I seek forgiveness. I have been advised to take a few days off to rest and recover, so I am unable to write anything at the moment."
